# Consumer, provider, and platform names that must never appear in the v0.1
# contract core (.github/scripts/continuum_config.py).
#
# The two-toggle contract is the portability guarantee: one unchanged copy of
# Continuum must resolve every consumer. A consumer, provider, or platform name
# baked into the contract core would break that silently, so CI fails the build
# here rather than at migration time.
#
# This list is data, not workflow logic. Keeping it out of the contract core is
# required (the guard greps the core for exactly these tokens) and keeping it
# out of the active workflows is required too: the MVP boundary asserts that no
# active workflow names a consumer, so the guard reads the list from here
# instead of hard-coding it inline.
#
# One extended regular expression per line; a match on any line fails the build.
nanodictate
kodmai
coderabbit
pr[-_]agent
release-please
homebrew
macports
gradle
maven
android
xcode
notariz
codesign
